## Experience

- **Junior Quality Engineer — Kayease** (Dec 2025 – present). End-to-end testing of sales management systems and a school ERP across multiple roles; validation of teacher and student mobile apps including face-recognition attendance; testing of Shopify themes, e-commerce sites and internal web apps.
- **Web Developer — Saatvik Fincorp** (May – July 2025). Led a three-person team building a 10+ page business website; built testimonials, dark/light mode and responsive navigation; manual cross-device testing pre-launch.

## Projects

- **Diabetic Retinopathy Detection** — deep-learning system classifying retinopathy severity from retinal images; trained on 50,000 images; accuracy raised from 65% to 80%. Python, TensorFlow, Keras, CNN.
- **Brain Tumor Detection** — functional and usability testing for an AI-based detection app; test case design, bug reporting and model output verification.
